description: Monitor one skilled nursing facility across two CMS monthly files. Defaults to latest vs the prior snapshot. Returns field-level diffs for stars, nurse hours, turnover, inspection score, abuse icon, high-performing icon, fines, and occupancy. Care Compare shows this month only — rerun after the next file.

from.description: Earlier filedate YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to use the snapshot before to.

to.description: Later filedate. Omit to use the latest CMS file.

name: get_facility_changes
